section_summary.extract_value: This section (3.4 Convergent validity) reports validation results for the Polish BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2), indicating that body appreciation scores showed significant positive correlations with self-esteem, body-related pride (both hubristic and authentic), and positive affect, while showing significant negative associations with body-related shame, guilt, and BMI. The findings are reported for the whole group as well as separately for men and women, though specific correlation coefficients are referenced in Table 2 but not provided in the text.
